explore_intro: Building works, zakat, iftars, classes: give to the projects of verified mosques and follow them as they grow.
explore_trust: Every gift goes straight to the mosque's own verified account. Salat Time never handles the money.
geo_error: Your position is not available. Choose your mosque on the map to see campaigns near it.
empty_near: No open campaign near you yet
empty_body: Mosques publish their campaigns once our team has verified them. Come back soon, in sha Allah.
pledged_hint: Bank transfers announced, waiting for the mosque to confirm them
pledged_line: Plus {amount} announced by bank transfer, counted once the mosque confirms it.
upcoming_hint: This campaign has not started yet.
preview_notice: Preview: this campaign is not public ({state}). Only the mosque's managers and our team can see it.
wall_empty: Be the first to give to this campaign.
tax_receipt_note: Tax receipts (reçu fiscal) are issued by the mosque itself: ask it directly, quoting your donation reference.
not_taking_donations: This campaign does not take donations right now.
campaign_over: This campaign has ended. Thank you to everyone who gave; may Allah accept it.
choose_method: How do you want to give?
email_hint: For your receipt. Never shown on the page.
anonymous_hint: Your name stays hidden on the page; the mosque still sees it.
bank_submit_hint: You will see the mosque's bank details and your reference; nothing is charged here.
direct_body: It is paid to the mosque's own verified PayPal or bank account. Salat Time never receives or holds the money and takes no commission.
paypal_unreachable: PayPal cannot be reached right now. Please try again in a moment, or choose a bank transfer.
paypal_sandbox: Test mode: PayPal sandbox, no real money moves.
paypal_error: PayPal could not complete the payment. Nothing was charged; please try again.
paypal_unavailable: PayPal is not available right now. Please try again in a moment, or choose a bank transfer.
paypal_capture_failed: We could not confirm the payment with PayPal yet. If you were charged, it will be counted automatically; otherwise please try again.
paypal_declined: PayPal did not accept this payment. Nothing was counted; please try again or choose another way.
method_unavailable: This way of giving is not available for this campaign right now.
share_body: Every share can bring the mosque a new donor.
receipt_thanks: Thank you, may Allah reward you
receipt_thanks_name: Thank you {name}, may Allah reward you
receipt_failed_title: This donation did not go through
receipt_completed: Your gift of {amount} to “{campaign}” has reached {mosque}.
receipt_bank_pending: Your gift of {amount} to “{campaign}” is announced. Make the transfer below; {mosque} will confirm it on receipt.
receipt_paypal_pending: PayPal is still processing your gift of {amount}. It will be counted as soon as PayPal confirms it.
receipt_pending: Your gift of {amount} is waiting for confirmation.
receipt_cancelled: This donation of {amount} was cancelled. Nothing was counted.
receipt_failed: This payment of {amount} did not go through. Nothing was counted.
transfer_reference: Reference to write on the transfer
bank_intro: From your own bank, to the mosque's account below. Copy each detail with its button.
bank_unavailable: The mosque's bank details are being updated. You will receive them by email; you can also come back to this page later.
bank_reference_hint: Write the reference exactly as shown: it is how the mosque recognises your gift.
bank_sepa_hint: A SEPA transfer in euros usually arrives within 1 to 2 working days (instant transfers within seconds).
bank_confirm_hint: Your gift shows as “pledged” until the mosque confirms it arrived. We have sent you these details by email.
my_intro: Your gifts to mosque campaigns and where each one stands.
my_total: Received by the mosques, over {count} completed donations
my_empty: You have not given to a campaign yet.
mosque_none_body: This mosque has not published a campaign on Salat Time.
manage_intro: Raise funds for your mosque's projects. Donations go straight to your own accounts.
manage_how: How it works: add the mosque's PayPal or bank account (our team verifies it), write a campaign, then send it for review. Once approved it is public, and every gift goes directly to your account.
manage_empty_body: Start with a building project, your zakat collection or the Ramadan iftars.
problems_title: Before this campaign can go to review
problems_draft_title: You can write your campaign now; to publish it you will need:
problem_mosque_unverified: The mosque is not verified yet
problem_mosque_unverified_help: Our team verifies a mosque when one of its managers' requests is approved. Write to us if your mosque should already be verified.
problem_no_verified_payout: No verified account to receive donations
problem_no_verified_payout_help: Add the mosque's PayPal or bank account. Our team verifies it, usually within a few days.
problem_no_method: No way of giving is chosen
problem_no_method_help: Edit the campaign and allow PayPal, bank transfer or both.
problem_method_unverified: A chosen way of giving is not verified
problem_method_unverified_help: Each way of giving the campaign allows needs a verified account.
problem_ended_help: Edit the campaign and choose a later end date.
summary_hint: One or two sentences shown on the cards.
story_hint: Markdown: **bold**, *italic*, lists, links. What is the project, why, how much it costs, how the money will be used.
cover_hint: A wide picture (JPEG, PNG or WebP, 4 MB at most). Avoid recognisable faces without consent.
starts_hint: Optional: by default, when our team approves it.
ends_hint: Optional. The campaign ends at midnight ({timezone}).
methods_hint: Only the mosque's verified accounts can be chosen.
method_needs_verification: Add and verify this account first
paypal_platform_off: PayPal payments are not switched on on Salat Time yet: donors will see bank transfer only for now.
show_donor_names_hint: Donors can still choose to stay anonymous. Turn off to show amounts only.
locked_hint: The kind and the title are fixed once the campaign is approved.
status_help_draft: Draft: only you can see it. Send it for review when it is ready.
status_help_pending: Under review by our team. You will receive an email once it is decided.
status_help_active: Public: donors can give to it.
status_help_completed: Ended with its goal reached, alhamdulillah. It stays visible.
status_help_closed: Closed: it stays visible but no longer takes donations.
status_help_rejected: Our team asked for changes. Edit it, then send it for review again.
submit_body: Our team checks the campaign and the mosque's accounts, then approves it or asks for changes. You can still edit it meanwhile.
close_body: It will stop taking donations and stay visible as ended. Bank transfers already announced can still be confirmed.
delete_body: “{title}” will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
updates_intro: Tell donors how the project is going. Each piece of news appears on the campaign page.
delete_update_body: “{title}” will be removed from the campaign page.
confirm_body: Check your bank account for a transfer of {amount} with the reference {reference}. Once confirmed it counts as raised and the donor is thanked by email.
cancel_body: Use this when the transfer {reference} never arrived. It will no longer count as pledged.
donations_intro: Every gift to the mosque's campaigns. Confirm bank transfers once you see them on your account.
donations_receipts_note: Donors' emails are for your receipts and thanks only: please do not use them for anything else.
payouts_intro: Where donations go: the mosque's own PayPal and bank accounts.
payouts_direct_title: Donations go straight to these accounts
payouts_direct_body: Salat Time never receives the money. Donors pay the mosque directly by PayPal, or by bank transfer to the IBAN below.
payouts_paypal_intro: The mosque's PayPal account (preferably a business account in the association's name).
payouts_bank_intro: The association's bank account, for SEPA transfers.
payouts_review_note: Every new or changed account is checked by our team before it receives any donation; changing an account suspends it until then.
paypal_email_hint: The email address of the mosque's PayPal account.
merchant_id_hint: 13 characters, in your PayPal account settings. Used instead of the email when given.
account_holder_hint: Usually the association that runs the mosque.
iban_keep_hint: Current IBAN: {iban}. Leave empty to keep it.
payout_delete_body: Donors will no longer be able to give this way.
payout_saved_review: Saved. Our team will verify this account before it receives donations.
campaign_created: The campaign was saved as a draft.
campaign_locked: This campaign can no longer be edited.
campaign_cannot_delete: A campaign that is open or has received donations cannot be deleted; close it instead.
campaign_submitted: Sent for review. You will receive an email once it is decided.
campaign_not_submittable: This campaign is already under review or published.
pledge_confirmed: Confirmed: the donation now counts as raised.
v_too_many_pledges: Too many transfers were announced for this email address. Please try again in an hour.
v_name: Please write your name (at least 2 characters).
v_email: Please write a valid email address.
v_goal_range: The goal must be between {min} and {max}.
v_ends_on: The end date must be today or later, and after the start date.
v_iban: This IBAN is not valid. Please check it.
v_bic: This BIC is not valid (8 or 11 letters and digits).
v_paypal_required: Give the PayPal email or the merchant ID.
v_merchant_id: A PayPal merchant ID has 13 letters and digits.
v_method_unverified: This account is not verified yet.
admin_intro: Campaigns to review and mosque accounts to verify. Money never passes through the platform.
admin_campaigns_intro: Every campaign is approved by our team before it is public.
admin_payouts_page_intro: Verify each account against the mosque's documents before it receives donations.
admin_paypal_off: PayPal is not configured (PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID and PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET): donors are offered bank transfers only.
admin_webhook_off: The PayPal webhook is not configured (PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_ID): refunds and late captures are not recorded automatically.
admin_paypal_sandbox: PayPal runs in sandbox mode: no real money moves until PAYPAL_MODE=live.
admin_payouts_intro: New or changed PayPal and bank accounts.
admin_verify_body: Confirm that it belongs to the mosque (documents, association name). Donations will be able to reach it, and the managers are told by email.
admin_unverify_body: The account stops receiving donations until it is verified again.
admin_reveal_body: The full number is shown only to you, and this access is recorded with your name.
admin_approve_body: It becomes public at once and donors can give to it. The managers are told by email.
admin_reject_body: The campaign goes back to the mosque with your note; they can edit it and send it again.
admin_note_hint: Say what should change. It is sent by email to the mosque's managers.
admin_note_required: Please explain what should change (at least 3 characters).
admin_close_body: It stops taking donations at once and stays visible as closed.
admin_problems_title: This campaign cannot be approved yet
admin_open_mosque: Open the mosque in the administration
admin_campaign_approved: The campaign is approved and public.
admin_campaign_rejected: Changes requested; the managers were told.
admin_campaign_changed: The mosque changed this campaign while you were reviewing it. Reload the page and review the new version.
admin_payout_verified: The account is verified; the managers were told.
admin_payout_changed: The mosque changed this account while you were reviewing it. Reload the page and check the new details.
mail_thanks_subject: Thank you for your donation to “{campaign}”
mail_thanks_line: Your gift of {amount} to {mosque} for “{campaign}” has been received.
mail_direct: The money went directly to the mosque's own account; Salat Time never handled it.
mail_tax_receipt: Tax receipts (reçu fiscal) are issued by the mosque: ask it directly, quoting your reference.
mail_dua: May Allah accept it from you and reward you with good.
mail_bank_line: Thank you for choosing to support {mosque} (“{campaign}”). Here are the details for your bank transfer:
mail_bank_reference: Reference to write on the transfer: {reference}
mail_bank_sepa: A SEPA transfer in euros usually arrives within 1 to 2 working days.
mail_bank_confirm: The mosque confirms your gift once it arrives; you will then receive a thank-you email.
mail_approved_line: Our team approved “{campaign}”. It is now public and donors can give to it.
mail_approved_next: Share it with your community, and post news as the project moves forward.
mail_rejected_line: Our team reviewed “{campaign}” and asks for a few changes before publishing it.
mail_rejected_next: Once it is updated, send it for review again from its page.
mail_payout_subject: Your account for donations is verified
mail_payout_line: Our team verified the {method} account of {mosque}. Donations can now reach it.
